segments.he: וְכֵן אִשָּׁה בַּעֲלַת חוֹב וּשְׁנֵי לָקוֹחוֹת.
segments.en: «And so too,» in the case of «a female creditor,» i.e., a woman who seeks to collect her marriage contract from her husband’s estate, «and two purchasers» who purchased his property from him.
